body:

Body **r3**, written 2026-10-01T03:50Z at stand-down (r2 at the R11 dispatch, r1 at seating, in the edit history).

## Current PM

⏳ **vacant** · last incumbent `session_01KTZmMfzVzjNvyaLyQ8mHvg` (os-warren), seated 2026-10-01 ~02:00Z on the maintainer's order 「objecui 仓库的 skills你应该也要处理」, stood down 2026-10-01T03:50Z on the maintainer's order 「当前任务处理完就下班」. Reads of this board go through REST with the session token; writes through objectstack's `scripts/pm/` tools with `--repo objectstack-ai/objectui` (the objectui repository must be attached to the session with API access first — this shift the maintainer approved that grant).

After approval: clear `needs-user-decision`, relay `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` with `--repo objectstack-ai/objectui`, confirm MERGED, close #11183 (strip `pm:dispatched` + assignee).
  - **PR #11316** (#11011): record 5924031392 on `e98c3c93c`, ACCEPT 5924034829, 速读 5924039524. Same recipe; closes #11011.
- **Queue at stand-down** (`pm:queue`, next in take-order): #11009 (p2, `bug`, `rules/protocol.md` 「Readers only.」; unlocked 02:10Z, serial after #11183's merge on that file), #11256 (p2, `guides/schema-expressions.md` "never blocks submit" — ADR-0137 D2/D3 live in objectstack `docs/adr/0137-predicate-fault-semantics-are-contract.md`; PR objectui#11233 merged `af9e9572c`; no open PR touches the file), #11198 (p3, `guides/app-composition.md` nav label; separate governed PR after #11183). - `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` → **PR #11316** until MERGED.
- `skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md` → #11256 (queued). `skills/objectui/guides/app-composition.md` → #11198 (queued).
- Every other file of the lane: FREE.

## Notes

- **Landing on this board.** `skills/**`, `.claude/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/adr/**` are objectui's governed surfaces: a PR touching any stays draft until an APPROVED review by `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` (`os-zhuang` / `hotlong`); then the seat lands it (ready + auto-merge → the merge queue; a direct merge is refused 405).
- **Changesets.** A docs-only PR carries an EMPTY-frontmatter changeset; the `skip-changeset` label object exists on this board but is a phantom wired to nothing — ⛔ never apply it.
- **Comments.** objectui's `AGENTS.md` bans model identifiers in comments; the claim template's `Container & model:` line conflicts with it — objectstack#21048 carries the conflict; until it lands, name the tier as `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` wherever the recogniser allows.
- **Gates for `skills/**` edits**: `check:skills-paths`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:skill-eval-tokens` (an eval-token oracle, not a size meter — objectui has no skills line/token ratchet), `check:new-line-citations` (differential; cite by content, never `path:line`), `lint.yml`'s roster; heavy steps under objectstack's `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.
- **Deploy registration.** A merge to `main` publishes nothing by itself (publishing runs only through `changeset-release.yml`'s explicit publish lane); the published skills catalog ships by `npx skills add`, so a wrong `skills/**` line is installed elsewhere before anyone here reads it.
